i.norm: Verifies that {@code withRequireTypeIdForSubtypes(false)} produces a new, distinct Value: deriving from EMPTY changes the "require type id" setting, so the derived Value is no longer equal to EMPTY, while unrelated settings (id visibility, writing type id for default impl) keep their EMPTY defaults.
Changing "require type id for subtypes" makes the derived Value differ from EMPTY, and inequality holds in both directions.
Settings unaffected by this mutation retain their EMPTY defaults.
